model_route: Flowable-AE v2 primary route with Flowable local rule v1 second-stage candidate
validation_scope: Formal enable candidate for Flowable local rule v1 second stage. This is not the default formal profile and does not replace flowable_v2.json.
description: Flowable second-stage formal enable candidate profile. It keeps the Flowable-AE v2 grey zone and enables Flowable-specific local rule v1 only for candidate review and controlled validation.
result_description: Runner reports summary_dur20.csv, summary_dur60.csv, body_valid_stats_dur20.json and body_valid_stats_dur60.json when Flowable REST and score service are available.
notes: Formal enable candidate only. Do not use as the default Flowable profile, do not describe flowable_v2.json as enabled, and do not use this as evidence for Flowable-GAN.
runtime_requirements: Flowable REST should be available at FLOWABLE_BASE, defaulting to http://127.0.0.1:8080 in the runner template.
The AE score service should be started with the Flowable-AE v2 model and meta.
Use this profile only by explicit review or validation selection.
